source: QUAD-FULL-METHODOLOGY.pdf and .txt, 86 pages, dated 15 November 2026, installed 18 November 2026
note: Rules of section 9A, 6 to 9 and 11 of that file, written in English. Every rule is CLASSICAL unless its label says otherwise. No rule has a validated hit rate. 52 pre registered rule tests came out at chance, mean lift 0.960.

rules.name: DK karaka placement
rules.trigger: The Chara dasha or sub period sign holds the DK, or the DK throws a Jaimini rashi aspect on it, or the DK sits in the 7th sign from it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: base rate and lift are for all fields together

rules.name: DKN, Upapada and Darapada
rules.trigger: The same relation of the dasha sign to the DKN sign, the Upapada and the Darapada, that is the DK in the 7th from each of them.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: no separate measure available

rules.name: Field relation 1 and 7
rules.trigger: From the Kaal Chakra dasha sign the 7th sign is related in D1 and D9 both, and the natural significator Venus sits there or aspects it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: overall lift 1.08, p 0.098, the only rule of the study that points the right way, still CLASSICAL, it selects a period and not a state

rules.name: Antardasha lord related to the 7th, strict
rules.trigger: The antardasha lord is the lord of the 7th house.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: empty on the true date in both recorded experiments

rules.name: Dasha and antardasha relation matrix
rules.trigger: Both lords related or unrelated and the functional class of each decide the cell of the matrix.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: the cell read bad in recorded experiment 2 and the marriage still happened, the Yogakaraka cell has the worst lift of the study, 0.47

rules.name: Nakshatra lord and dasha lord in one house
rules.trigger: The nakshatra lord sits in the 7th from the progressed lagna and the dasha lord sits with it in that house.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Birth lagna in the progressed 7th
rules.trigger: During the Yogini dasha the birth lagna falls in the 7th house of the progressed chart.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: printed by the engine in recorded experiment 2 but not on the checklist, no separate measure

rules.name: Goel third reference point
rules.trigger: The dasha lord is tied to the nakshatra lord in the progressed chart.
rules.label: VACUOUS
rules.note: fired on 11 of 11 dates in recorded experiment 2, a witness that fires on everything has not discriminated

rules.name: Double transit ladder
rules.trigger: Saturn within a year, Jupiter within six months, Sun within a month and Moon within three days link the points.
rules.label: VACUOUS
rules.note: all four together 86.6 percent on random dates, above the limit of 85, not computed by this build

rules.name: Dasha lord indicator, loose form
rules.trigger: The MD or AD lord is the lord of the house, sits in it or aspects it.
rules.label: VACUOUS

rules.name: PK karaka in the 5th
rules.trigger: The PK sits in the 5th sign from the Chara dasha sign or aspects it by Jaimini aspect.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Field relation 1 and 5
rules.trigger: From the Kaal Chakra dasha sign the 5th sign is related in D1 and D7 and Jupiter sits there or aspects it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Dasha of the 6th house sign
rules.trigger: The Chara dasha is that of the sign of the 6th house.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: a caution, the 6th is the 2nd from the 5th, a maraka place for children, not a prediction

rules.name: Sub period 6th or 8th from the main sign
rules.trigger: The Chara sub period sign is the 6th or the 8th from the main dasha sign, above all when the AK looks at it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Birth date of the child
rules.trigger: After the dashas narrow the window, Jupiter within nine months over or aspecting both parents' PK in D1 and D7, Sun within four days, Moon 30 to 36 hours before.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: base rate 64.7 to 99.2 percent, all three together 17.3 percent, lift 1.22, n 19, p 0.42, needs both parents' charts, not run in this build

rules.name: Progressed lagna and the 11th
rules.trigger: The birth 11th house becomes the progressed lagna or the birth lagna falls in the progressed 11th.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Yogini in D7
rules.trigger: The same progression laid on D7.
rules.label: HAND ARITHMETIC
rules.note: not computed by the engine in this build

rules.name: AmK in the 10th or 11th
rules.trigger: The AmK sits in the 10th or 11th sign from the Chara dasha or sub period sign, or aspects it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: on 22 quiz career questions the chart method scored 45.5 percent and the no chart control also 45.5

rules.name: AmK read in three steps
rules.trigger: Step one the AmK in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from the Lagna. Step two the aspects on it. Step three the conjunctions with it. Timing when the AmK sign dasha runs, or the sign from which the AmK is the 10th or 11th, and Vimshottari shows the same.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: step two and three are descriptive, only step one is tested here

rules.name: Ten Jaimini rajayogas with the navamsha filter
rules.trigger: Any pair of AK, AmK, PK, DK and the 5th lord in conjunction or mutual rashi aspect. Count in D1 then in D9, the ones that stay in D9 are effective.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: promise only, no timing formula in the source

rules.name: AK and AmK placement
rules.trigger: AmK from the AK in a kendra, trikona or the 11th gives high position with little struggle, in the 6th, 8th or 12th struggle, in the 10th the best place found by Rao.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Field relation 1 and 10
rules.trigger: From the Kaal Chakra dasha sign the 10th sign is related in D1 and D10 and the significator Sun, with Saturn and Mercury, sits there or aspects it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: career upward lift 1.10 n 22, career downward 1.04 n 16, neither significant

rules.name: Related benefic antardasha in a Yogakaraka or trikona mahadasha
rules.trigger: The mahadasha lord is a Yogakaraka and the antardasha lord is a benefic related to it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: true hits 2 of 22, 9.1 percent, the worst result of the whole study, never decisive alone

rules.name: Related malefic antardasha in a Yogakaraka dasha
rules.trigger: In a Yogakaraka mahadasha the antardasha of a related Trishadaya, 8th lord or benefic kendra lord.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: the author says the large gains land here, no separate measure

rules.name: Exchange of lagna lord and 10th lord, or 9th and 10th lords
rules.trigger: The two lords exchange signs or sit in each other's houses, the yoga is read to fructify in both lords' dasha and antardasha.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Dasha sign taken as lagna, rajayoga
rules.trigger: A rajayoga forms when the Kaal Chakra dasha sign is taken as lagna and the foundation chart also holds the promise of authority.
rules.label: HAND ARITHMETIC
rules.note: the foundation chart ceiling applies to every yoga, the engine does not rotate the chart to the dasha sign

rules.name: Dasha of Sagittarius or Leo
rules.trigger: The Chara dasha is that of Sagittarius or Leo.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: rise and fall signs, lift below one, the wrong way

rules.name: Dasha of the AK sign
rules.trigger: The Chara dasha is that of the sign holding the AK or the sign from which the AK is the 10th.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: High voltage signs
rules.trigger: The Kaal Chakra dasha is that of Sagittarius, Leo or Gemini.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Field relation 1 and 4
rules.trigger: From the Kaal Chakra dasha sign the 4th sign is related in D1 and D24 and Jupiter and Mercury sit there or aspect it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: on 23 quiz education questions the chart method stood 17.4 points ahead of the control, 56.5 against 39.1 percent, McNemar p 0.454. The level of the degree cannot be told from this

rules.name: ECMCD events fix the lagna
rules.trigger: Dates of education, career, marriage, children and death are used to set the lagna degree when birth time is missing.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: a no birth time method, not a rule for options

rules.name: Education through the 4th and 5th karaka list
rules.trigger: Quick lookup row: Chara reads the karaka list of the 4th and 5th, Vimshottari the lords of the 4th and 5th, Yogini the progressed 4th.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Field relation 1 and 4, property
rules.trigger: From the Kaal Chakra dasha sign the 4th sign is related in D1, D4, D10 and D20 and the significator Mars for dry land, Moon for irrigated, Venus for residence sits there or aspects it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: no separate lift measured

rules.name: Field relation 1 and 11, vehicle
rules.trigger: From the Kaal Chakra dasha sign the 11th sign is related in D1 and D16 and Venus for passenger vehicles, Mars for heavy, Saturn for transport sits there or aspects it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Land and buildings in D4
rules.trigger: The same progression laid on D4.
rules.label: HAND ARITHMETIC
rules.note: not computed by the engine in this build

rules.name: Related malefic antardasha in a Yogakaraka dasha, large gains
rules.trigger: Large gains land in the antardasha of a related Trishadaya lord, 8th lord or benefic kendra lord of a Yogakaraka dasha.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Related maraka antardasha, fame without wealth
rules.trigger: The related maraka antardasha in a Yogakaraka dasha gives the least, fame and recognition without wealth in hand.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: 11th house as the house of expansion
rules.trigger: The 11th lord or a planet in the 11th active, and above all when the birth 11th becomes the progressed lagna.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Dasha sign as lagna, wealth and poverty yogas
rules.trigger: Wealth and poverty yogas read with the dasha sign taken as lagna.
rules.label: HAND ARITHMETIC

rules.name: Quantity of wealth
rules.trigger: There is no separate field table in the source for the amount of wealth.
rules.label: NO RULE
rules.note: any claim about an amount is HAND ARITHMETIC

rules.name: BK in the 3rd
rules.trigger: The BK sits in the 3rd sign from the Chara dasha sign or aspects it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: activates the field only

rules.name: Birth date of a sibling on D3
rules.trigger: The D3 lagna, BK and the 3rd and 11th houses of the elder sibling marked, then Jupiter, Mars, Sun and Moon of the younger over them, and the elder's running Chara BK in the 3rd or 11th.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: not run in this build, needs both siblings' charts

rules.name: Yogini in D3
rules.trigger: The same progression laid on D3, siblings and courage.
rules.label: HAND ARITHMETIC

rules.name: Number of siblings
rules.trigger: There is no counting rule of siblings in the source.
rules.label: NO RULE
rules.note: measured 2 of 15, 13.3 percent against random 24.3 and the no chart control 26.7. Give a size weighted population estimate by the native's age group and own gender and write NO RULE. The 3rd and 11th and BK reading is a note and does not choose the option

rules.name: Father, BK and Sun in the 3rd
rules.trigger: The BK or the Sun sits in the 3rd from the Chara dasha sign or aspects it. BK plus Sun is the father.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Mother, MK and Moon in the 4th
rules.trigger: The MK or the Moon sits in the 4th from the Chara dasha sign or aspects it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Yogini in D12
rules.trigger: The same progression laid on D12, the father from the 9th and the mother from the 4th.
rules.label: HAND ARITHMETIC

rules.name: Childhood dasha describes the family
rules.trigger: In a young native every strong dasha is first the action on the family and guardians.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: the attribution rule

rules.name: Parents alive
rules.trigger: On 15 quiz questions of the parents the chart method scored 86.7 percent and the no chart control 73.3 percent on the same set.
rules.label: VACUOUS
rules.note: This matches the life tables for the age. Write the native's age and the parents' probable age against the options first, that information decides much of the answer before the chart is opened

rules.name: GK in the 6th
rules.trigger: The GK sits in the 6th sign from the Chara dasha sign or aspects it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: on 8 quiz health questions 50.0 against 50.0 percent, zero difference. The most used rule gave no effect

rules.name: Rao caution 1
rules.trigger: A sub period of the 6th or 8th sign from the main sign, above all in the AK's aspect.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Rao caution 2
rules.trigger: The AK falls in the 8th from the running main or sub period sign.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Sagittarius dasha, accident, sudden illness, violent event
rules.trigger: The Chara dasha or sub period is Sagittarius. The event may touch a member of the family and not the native.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Dasha sign in a maraka state
rules.trigger: The dasha sign is one of the eight maraka conditions of Jataka Parijata 17 verses 34 to 36.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: no separate base rate, the deha and jiva dasha lift is 0.82 at base rate 20.2

rules.name: Maraka dasha, general condition
rules.trigger: The lord of the MD or AD is a maraka.
rules.label: VACUOUS

rules.name: Yogini dasha or nakshatra lord a maraka
rules.trigger: The Yogini dasha lord or the nakshatra lord is a maraka.
rules.label: VACUOUS

rules.name: Weak lagna and Moon, intense effect
rules.trigger: Both lagna and Moon weak and afflicted, or Kemadruma and Shakata yoga.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Organ level disease or the name of a disease
rules.trigger: There is no rule for this in the source.
rules.label: NO RULE
rules.note: answer from population statistics and keep the chart reading as a note. A question that rests on diagnosis, a treatment decision or somebody's physical safety gets the reading and one sentence that it is not medical evidence

rules.name: DK and DKN in the dasha sign
rules.trigger: The DK or the DKN sits in the Chara dasha sign or aspects it. Rao says death comes when a maraka period comes whether it is the AK dasha or not.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: the one death rule with lift above one, not significant

rules.name: Field relation 1 and 8
rules.trigger: The 8th sign from the Kaal Chakra dasha sign is related.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: the weakest of the field relations

rules.name: Deha and jiva dasha
rules.trigger: The Kaal Chakra dasha is the deha or the jiva sign.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Eight maraka conditions and the completion of life span
rules.trigger: A maraka dasha gives death only when the native has run out the life span, otherwise it foretells accident, illness, debt, stigma, accusation, humiliation, anguish, official anger, defeat, separation, loneliness, marginalisation, prison and grief.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Maraka order
rules.trigger: Second lord, malefic in the 2nd, 7th lord, malefic in the 7th, malefic with the 2nd lord, malefic with the 7th lord, 8th lord, the 3rd or 8th lord with the 2nd or 7th lord, Saturn with any maraka which displaces all, 6th lord, the weakest planet.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Which antardasha gives death
rules.trigger: Death in the antardasha of an unrelated malefic. A related malefic is a suspected killer. Not in a related benefic and not in any Yogakaraka antardasha.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Death axis pairs
rules.trigger: One lord's dasha and the other's antardasha for the pairs 1 and 7, 2 and 12, 3 and 11, 4 and 10, 5 and 9, 6 and 8. For movable lagna the 2nd and 7th, fixed the 3rd and 8th, dual the 7th and 11th.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Longevity class
rules.trigger: From the sign nature of the lagna lord and the 8th lord. Movable and movable long. Movable and fixed medium. Movable and dual short. Fixed and dual long. Dual and dual medium. Fixed and fixed short. The sign-type rule of the file.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Gulika chain of the date of death
rules.trigger: Year by transit Saturn 5th or 9th from birth Gulika, month by transit Sun 5th or 9th from the 8th lord's sign, then day and hour.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: the author self marks 3 of 5 and on one real death the longevity class said medium and the native lived to 89. Not run in this build. A death date is never given

rules.name: The three moves and the repeat of Simhavalokana
rules.trigger: Rao predicted the death of Rajiv Gandhi on this.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: the lift of the moves is 0.81 to 0.95 in every specification, the wrong way

rules.name: Kinds of travel
rules.trigger: From the Kaal Chakra dasha sign the 3rd is regular travel, the 9th long travel, the 12th foreign culture, the 8th expulsion. Karaka Moon.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Change of place in a leap transition
rules.trigger: All three signs of Simhavalokana present, the result is sometimes a change of residence.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Westward travel with benefic influence
rules.trigger: When benefic influence is strong on these transitions there is pleasure in travel to the west.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Questions of residence
rules.trigger: On 8 quiz questions the chart method scored 37.5 percent against the control 25.0.
rules.label: NO RULE
rules.note: no proof. Abroad through the 12th has no direct rule in Chara, Vimshottari or Yogini, anything said is HAND ARITHMETIC

rules.name: Maraka dasha, stigma, accusation, prison, official anger
rules.trigger: The Kaal Chakra dasha sign is one of the eight maraka conditions.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: 6th lord in a malefic class
rules.trigger: The lord of the 6th is in the inauspicious class.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Rao's three cautions
rules.trigger: A sub period of the 6th or 8th, the AK in the 8th, the dasha of the 6th house sign.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Side or result of a case
rules.trigger: The rules do not decide the winner of a case. The source says only that maraka conditions bring stigma, prison and official anger.
rules.label: HAND ARITHMETIC

rules.name: Promise before time
rules.trigger: No dasha gives what the birth chart does not allow. If the user says the event has happened the promise question is closed by that statement.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Relation between the two period lords is the gate
rules.trigger: The quality of the lords does not reduce a witness that rests on a relation, the shortfall is written and not deducted.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: No fruit in own antardasha
rules.trigger: A dasha lord does not give its good result in its own antardasha.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
rules.note: indicator rule, not significant

rules.name: Middle antardasha extends the previous result
rules.trigger: An inauspicious antardasha between two auspicious ones extends the earlier fruit. Not giving is not the same as giving loss. The end of the last dasha spreads to the start of the next.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Venus and Saturn reversal
rules.trigger: When Venus and Saturn are unrelated, each gives the other's result in the dasha and antardasha of the other.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Exchange of kendra and trikona
rules.trigger: Kendra lords give their good in the antardasha of trikona lords and trikona lords in the antardasha of kendra lords.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Transit is a trigger and not a cause
rules.trigger: Capacity in the birth chart, tendency in the dasha, opportunity in the transit. State a transit with its base rate. A transit written from memory is HAND ARITHMETIC.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Sadharmi and Atmasambandhi sieve
rules.trigger: The two lords of like functional character, or natural friends, or both exalted or both debilitated.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Pachaka, Bodhaka, Karaka and Vedhaka
rules.trigger: The four fixed planets of each dasha lord and their positions and relations.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Comparative judgement
rules.trigger: Judge every dasha against the one before it.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: Navamsha filter
rules.trigger: In every count of a rajayoga count it in D1 and then keep what survives in D9.
rules.label: CLASSICAL

rules.name: A dasha that never came
rules.trigger: A yoga that never gets a dasha in the whole life does not bear fruit, the Kashmir pony rule.
rules.label: CLASSICAL
